meta.title: ROLLER — PVC and aluminium profile systems in Tajikistan
meta.description: ROLLER is Tajikistan's first manufacturer of PVC materials. PVC windows and doors, aluminium and facade systems. Warmth and comfort for every home.

common.slogan: Warmth and comfort for every home

hero.headline: Warmth and comfort for every home
hero.subtext: PVC and aluminium windows, doors and facade systems. Six systems for different budgets and different jobs — from a single flat to the facade of a residential complex.

brands.title: Six systems — <accent>one</accent> for your job
brands.description: Four PVC systems and two aluminium ones. They differ in profile depth, chamber count and what they are built for.

applications.title: Start from the job, not from the material
applications.description: Windows, doors, sliding systems and facades. Which profile suits them is our job to work out.

windows.title: Windows
windows.description: PVC and aluminium window systems for flats, private houses and commercial buildings.
windows.menuDescription: PVC and aluminium for any opening
windows.heading: PVC and aluminium windows in Dushanbe
windows.intro: We make windows in our own plant in Dushanbe, from the three-chamber economy series to a premium 75 mm profile. Survey, manufacture, delivery and installation are all done by our own teams.
windows.metaTitle: PVC windows in Dushanbe — PVC and aluminium, direct from the maker
windows.metaDescription: PVC and aluminium windows in Dushanbe direct from ROLLER: six profile systems, survey, manufacture and installation. Priced per project.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Entrance groups, balcony doors and internal doors in PVC and thermally broken aluminium.
doors.heading: PVC and aluminium doors in Dushanbe
doors.intro: Door sets are built to the opening: thermally broken aluminium entrances for heated buildings, light aluminium doors for shops, and PVC balcony doors.
doors.metaTitle: Aluminium doors in Dushanbe — made-to-order PVC and aluminium doors
doors.metaDescription: Made-to-order aluminium and PVC doors in Dushanbe: entrance groups, balcony and internal doors from ROLLER. Survey and installation included.

sliding-systems.title: Sliding systems
sliding-systems.description: Sliding windows and doors for balconies, terraces and panoramic openings.
sliding-systems.heading: Sliding windows and doors in Dushanbe
sliding-systems.intro: Sliding units save room where a hinged sash has nowhere to swing: on a balcony, on a terrace, in a narrow passage. Built on both cold and thermally broken aluminium profiles.
sliding-systems.metaTitle: Sliding windows and doors in Dushanbe
sliding-systems.metaDescription: Aluminium sliding systems for balconies, terraces and panoramic openings in Dushanbe. Made by ROLLER, survey and installation included.

facade-glazing.title: Facade glazing
facade-glazing.description: Facade systems for residential complexes, business centres and retail buildings.
facade-glazing.heading: Facade glazing in Dushanbe
facade-glazing.intro: We work with developers on volume and on schedule: glazing for residential complexes, curtain walling for business centres, entrance groups for retail buildings. Making the profile ourselves is what keeps large batches on time.
facade-glazing.metaTitle: Facade glazing in Dushanbe — aluminium facade systems
facade-glazing.metaDescription: Facade glazing for residential complexes and business centres in Dushanbe: cold and thermally broken aluminium systems from ROLLER.

mosquito-nets.title: Insect screens
mosquito-nets.description: Screens for windows and doors, made to the size of the opening.
mosquito-nets.menuDescription: For windows and doors, made to size
mosquito-nets.heading: Insect screens in Dushanbe
mosquito-nets.intro: Screens are made to one specific opening — framed for windows, hinged for doors. They have no catalogue of their own: the size is taken at the survey along with the window.
mosquito-nets.metaTitle: Insect screens in Dushanbe — for windows and doors
mosquito-nets.metaDescription: Insect screens for windows and doors in Dushanbe, made to the size of the opening. Made by ROLLER, survey and fitting included.

partitions.title: Partitions
partitions.description: Office and retail partitions in cold aluminium with a slim profile.
partitions.heading: Aluminium partitions in Dushanbe
partitions.intro: Partitions divide an office, a shop or a showroom without eating the daylight. A slim 45 mm cold profile is the right answer where no heating is needed but geometry and rigidity are.
partitions.metaTitle: Aluminium partitions in Dushanbe — office and retail
partitions.metaDescription: Office and retail partitions in aluminium profile, Dushanbe. Made by ROLLER: survey, manufacture and installation.

production.title: Our own plant, not <accent>resale</accent>
production.description: We extrude the profile ourselves: from extrusion to the finished unit, survey and installation. That is how we hold schedules at developer volumes and answer for the whole result.

pvc.title: PVC products
pvc.description: Window and door systems for flats, private houses and commercial buildings.
pvc.heading: PVC profile systems
pvc.intro: Four systems on one ladder: ECOLINE closes an opening dependably and cheaply, ROLLER is the baseline choice for a flat, UNOPEN handles a noisy street and large openings, and STELLA gives the most warmth and quiet.
pvc.metaDescription: Four PVC systems made by ROLLER: ECOLINE, ROLLER, UNOPEN and STELLA — 60 to 75 mm, 3 to 5 chambers. Priced per project.

aluminium.title: Aluminium products
aluminium.description: Thermally broken, facade and sliding aluminium solutions for contemporary architecture.
aluminium.heading: Aluminium profile systems
aluminium.intro: Two systems for two jobs: the cold ALD-45 for shopfronts, partitions and unheated terraces, and the thermally broken THERMO 60 for facades and panoramic glazing on heated buildings.
aluminium.metaDescription: Aluminium systems made by ROLLER: the cold ALD-45 (45 mm) and the thermally broken THERMO 60 (60 mm) for facades, shopfronts and partitions.

ecoline.heading: ECOLINE — 60 mm economy PVC profile
ecoline.description: A baseline three-chamber series: it closes the opening dependably and without paying for more. Supplied in white profile only.

roller.heading: ROLLER — 60 mm PVC profile for flats and houses
roller.description: A practical series for flats, houses and offices that need a dependable baseline balance of warmth, quiet and cost.

unopen.heading: UNOPEN — reinforced 65 mm PVC profile
unopen.description: A versatile system for residential and commercial buildings that need a reinforced profile without moving up to premium.

stella.heading: STELLA — premium 75 mm PVC profile
stella.description: A series for projects with higher demands on thermal insulation, acoustics and tighter profile geometry.

ald-45.heading: ALD-45 — 45 mm cold aluminium profile
ald-45.description: A cold aluminium series for partitions, terraces, shopfronts and light commercial structures with a slim profile.

thermo-60.heading: THERMO 60 — 60 mm thermally broken aluminium profile
thermo-60.description: Thermally broken aluminium for facades, entrance groups and large openings where architecture and energy efficiency matter.

specs.title: Technical specification
specs.description: The system's parameters. Unit sizes are calculated against your opening at the survey — there are no stock sizes.

colors.title: Lamination colours
colors.description: Wood-effect lamination and plain finishes. The colour is applied to the profile at the plant, so it does not fade and never needs painting.
colors.single: This system ships in white profile only.

applications.title: Where it is used
applications.description: The jobs this system is specified for.

thermal.title: Thermal insulation
thermal.description: A multi-chamber profile keeps heat inside and cuts what you spend on heating.

acoustic.title: Sound insulation
acoustic.description: Sealing contours and the glazing unit noticeably cut street noise.

durability.title: Durability
durability.description: PVC does not corrode or rot and never needs painting — shape and colour hold for years.

aesthetics.title: Colour and texture
aesthetics.description: Wood-effect lamination and plain finishes are chosen to match the facade and the interior.

ecology.title: Safety
ecology.description: The profile contains no toxic substances and is safe for living spaces.

strength.title: Light and strong
strength.description: Aluminium allows slim frames and a large glazed area at the same rigidity.

spans.title: Large openings
spans.description: These units carry the weight of shopfronts and panoramic sashes where PVC no longer works at that size.

weather.title: Weather resistance
weather.description: The powder coat neither fades nor corrodes, in sun or rain.

maintenance.title: Minimal upkeep
maintenance.description: The surface washes with ordinary cleaners and the coating never needs redoing.

section.title: Profile cross-section
section.description: Chambers, reinforcement and how the glazing unit sits — how the system is built inside. Full technical documentation on request.

warranty.title: Warranty terms
warranty.scope: The terms below apply to PVC profiles made by ROLLER.
warranty.covered: Light fastness, structural integrity and manufacturing defects. Where a defect covered by the warranty is found, the manufacturer undertakes to replace the faulty item with a new one.
warranty.excluded: Hardware, glazing units, and errors made while assembling and installing the windows and doors.
warranty.conditionsTitle: When the warranty does not apply
warranty.conditions: If the operating instructions are not followed, the customer cannot claim under the warranty.
